component.name: kabelsalat
component.summary: Live rack for synths and effects, wired with patch cables

description.p: kabelsalat turns your computer into a live setup: synths and effects sit in a rack, connected by patch cables that you can see and grab, and everything you play goes straight to the speakers.

ul.li: Host CLAP and LV2 instruments and effects (Surge XT, Dexed, Vitalium, …)
Patch on the back of the rack with animated cables
Run several rigs at once, each played from its own keyboard
Route MIDI anywhere: splits, channels, transposition, velocity ranges
Mix, record what you hear to WAV, and let an assistant set things up

description.p: Plugins are not bundled. The app finds those in ~/.clap and ~/.lv2, the host system's plugin folders and Flathub's LinuxAudio plugin extensions.
